Bug_Details:
Calling getAnnotation on an annotation that is not retained at runtime Calling getAnnotation on an annotation that does not have its Retention set to
RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME will always return null.
Bug_Explanation: The code attempts to retrieve an annotation that is not retained at runtime using getAnnotation. Since NonRuntimeAnnotation is set with RetentionPolicy.CLASS, it is not available at runtime, and getAnnotation will return null.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method triggers the bug by calling showBug, which attempts to retrieve an annotation not retained at runtime. This causes the method to incorrectly return 'Annotation is null', resulting in a test failure.
